blocks.title: Content lives in Git
blocks.body: Every publish is a commit, so content has history, review, and rollback for free.

blocks.title: Nothing at runtime
blocks.body: Pages are built from files on disk. The CMS is never in the request path, so it can never be the reason a page is slow or down.

blocks.title: Your design stays yours
blocks.body: The CMS stores content shapes, never markup. Every component on this page is ordinary Astro the studio cannot see or break.

blocks.text: The best CMS dependency is the one your production site does not have.
